allocationOverhead.source: Forecast transfer allowance $0.15/GiB for one verified final release upload; not an invoice. Compute, <=1 TiB gp3, IPv4 covered by $24/allocation-hour. https://aws.amazon.com/ec2/pricing/on-demand/

rate.source: Conservative allocation allowance: AWS Ohio Linux OnDemand p4d.24xlarge (all eight A100 GPUs) is $21.95764/hour, price list published 2026-09-10; remainder covers up to 1 TiB gp3 and one public IPv4. https://pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/AmazonEC2/current/us-east-2/index.json

protocol.cachePolicy: Pre-read and hash pinned inputs before each independent eight-rank process; empty per-point compiler caches; reset strict-loaded weights, optimizer, full scheduler and RNG. SDPA attention in all points and the projected full recipe.

checkpoint.scope: Full model weights only, matching the upstream periodic checkpoint; additional upstream final-model save belongs to one-time finalization.

dataset.selection: All 24 pinned upstream GR1 RoboCasa *_1000 task folders, 24,000 trajectories; continuation from released post-trained weights.

evaluation.scope: One ordinary training-batch predict_action evaluation (20 DDIM steps), measured after first point; no held-out policy quality or simulator evaluation.
